dataset.name: VIVI MVP Synthetic AI Search Dataset

policies.missing_snapshot_fallback: Use date:YYYY-MM-DD from collected_at in its recorded timezone. The date identifies the available collection round when no snapshot ID exists. Snapshot/date namespaces remain separate; this does not guess that a missing-snapshot row belongs to a populated snapshot. Production ingestion should supply a stable collection_run_id.
policies.canonical_selection: Prefer complete > partial > failed, then requested language match, then latest collected_at, then lexicographically greatest observation_id. Preserve every attempt and the canonical mapping. possible_duplicate alone does not disqualify a row.
policies.metric_eligibility: One canonical row per question/channel/batch; complete and response_language matches questions.language. Exclude partial, failed and language-mismatch rows from mention/citation denominators; show their coverage separately. Partial evidence remains inspectable but absence is not a negative observation.
policies.summary_authority: Recompute target_mentioned, mention_count and citation_count from mentions/citations; retain reported values in the audit.
policies.source_metadata: Missing title uses domain or URL for display. An external source with null brand_id is valid. An owned source with null brand_id remains unresolved in authoritative metrics; domain-match attribution is a separate candidate metric.
policies.similar_questions: Keep distinct question_id values; semantic similarity is not proof of duplicate collection. Do not sum synthetic interest as unique market demand.
policies.interpretation: Observed mentions/citations are associations in synthetic data, not proof of content quality, actual product capability, causal effect, market demand, or future improvement.
